notes: The infinitive absolute is read as in v12: null and is what the ASV spends on its emphasis, while make ... void is the finite verb's ordinary rendering, and the competing added reading for the and is named in that unit's note.
ʾaḥărēy before the infinitive takes after that under rule 52, headed on after as the word carrying the relation (rule 24).
The supplied them of hath heard them answers to no object morpheme and is added under rule 44.
